instruction: Candid full shot of an indoor martial arts gym with gray mats. On the right, the man in the blue sleeveless shirt (R1) stands clinching the opponent's head with both hands. On the left, the bearded man in the maroon t-shirt (R2) stands defending the clinch. Bright overhead lighting illuminates the neutral-toned training area.
elements: R1 applies a head clinch to R2
R1 uses both hands to control R2's head
R2 defends against the clinch rather than applying it
R1 and R2 stand in a martial arts clinch configuration
gray mats in an indoor martial arts gym
bright overhead lighting in a neutral-toned training area
